newsitem.title: USA: Nature's Sunshine names Hughes president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Nature's Sunshine names Hughes president, CEO.

text.p: Nature's Sunshine Products Inc said on Friday its board had named chairperson Kristine Hughes to the additional posts of president and chief executive.
The company said in a statement that Hughes replaced Alan D. Kennedy, who resigned on Friday.
"Mr. Kennedy made significant contributions to Nature's Sunshine during his tenure, but it was the board's decision that a new management approach was needed," Hughes said.
She said the company's objectives included maintaining Nature's Sunshine's annual sales growth in the 20-25 percent range.
The company expects to open a wholly owned subsidiary this year in Argentina, and new sales units will be added in Honduras and Nicaragua.
The listing of the copany's common stock on The New York Stock Exchange is under active consideration.
